'''Vilsics''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garos IV]]. Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] he worked as a flight systems coordinator at the [[Ariana]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Mission to Zila" />
